This is my signature recipe.
And what goes into it?

words.gram: genitive, н- form after a preposition

lines.trans: This is a secret that will die with me.
Tell me at least one secret ingredient.
You will never guess.
I can make one like it myself.
Do you seriously want to bet with me?
Yes, tonight I will recreate your pâté.
Here, take a piece.
If I guess, will you give a day off?
Fine, if you repeat it, you will get two days off.
It is a deal, tonight I will bring my dish!

This is my signature recipe.
And what goes into it?

lines.trans: This is a secret that will die with me.
Tell me at least one secret ingredient.
You will never guess.
I can make one like it myself.
Do you seriously want to bet with me?
Yes, tonight I will recreate your pâté.
Here, take a piece.
If I guess, will you give a day off?
Fine, if you repeat it, you will get two days off.
It is a deal, tonight I will bring my dish!
Good luck!

words.gram: feminine singular, genitive (wishing: 'I wish you luck')

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: instrumental of вечер used as an adverb

examples.trans: I'm at home in the evening.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: substantivized adjective, declines like an adjective

examples.trans: It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.text: Всё отлично, отдыхай! Сегодня выходные, всё круто!
examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.en: to guess, to work out, to think of

examples.trans: Why didn't I think of it at once!

examples.text: Какой глупый человек догадался это сделать?
examples.trans: What foolish person thought of doing that?

examples.text: Ты никогда сам не догадаешься об этом.
examples.trans: You will never guess this by yourself.

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.trans: There are only the freshest ingredients there.

examples.text: Скажите хотя бы один секретный ингредиент.
examples.trans: Tell me at least one secret ingredient.

examples.text: Можно ещё кусочек? И шампанское можно выпить?
examples.trans: May I have another slice? And can I drink the champagne?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Нам очень дорого обходится авторская кухня.
examples.trans: Auteur cuisine costs us very dearly.

examples.text: Это все, кто выходил из отеля.
examples.trans: That is everyone who left the hotel.
What is going on here right now?

meanings.note: Borrowed via German 'Pastete' from Old French/Italian 'pâté'/'pastetto', referring to finely ground seasoned meat or liver.

examples.trans: The chef prepares a signature pâté.
Chef, this is simply amazing pâté!

examples.text: Костя, быстро попробуй мой новый паштет.
examples.trans: Kostya, quickly taste my new pâté.

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again

examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.
So, repeat that clearly once more.

examples.text: А кто их получит? Те, кто сидит повыше?
examples.trans: And who will get it? The people who sit higher up?

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.text: Я торт приготовила. Ты любишь сладкое?
examples.trans: I made a cake. Do you have a sweet tooth?

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Шеф хранит свой тайный рецепт супа.
examples.trans: The chef keeps his secret soup recipe.

examples.text: Да? Это мой старый фирменный рецепт.
examples.trans: Really? This is my old signature recipe.
Before you is a unique ancient recipe.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: Borrowed via French 'secret' from Latin 'secretum' (something set apart or hidden).

examples.trans: These are our little men's secrets!

examples.text: А вы кем работаете, если не секрет?
examples.trans: And what do you do, if it is not a secret?

examples.text: А почему он на секретном совещании?
examples.trans: And why is he at a secret meeting?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?
That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

examples.text: Это кошмар, я не спорю. Но зачем на видео снимать?
examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue. But why film it on video?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Да, мадам, вы очень тонко угадали!
examples.trans: Yes, madam, that was a very shrewd guess!

examples.text: Если я угадаю, вы дадите выходной?
examples.trans: If I guess right, will you give me a day off?

examples.text: Ну-ка, попробуем ваш знаменитый фирменный соус.
examples.trans: Come on, let's try your famous signature sauce.

examples.text: Я могу приготовить своё фирменное блюдо.
examples.trans: I can make my signature dish.
The chef made his signature dish.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

хотя.gloss: even if, at least (with бы); although

meanings.note: нужно хотя бы поговорить = we need at least to talk

examples.text: Нужно хотя бы поговорить с ними.
examples.trans: We need at least to talk with them.

examples.text: Вы плохо поступили, но хотя бы совесть есть.
examples.trans: You acted badly, but at least you have a conscience.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
to go in, to come in, to enter

examples.trans: You go in and turn straight left.

examples.text: Входишь сразу налево, к администратору. Там сидит такой Лисицын.
examples.trans: You go in and turn straight left, to the administrator. A fellow named Lisitsyn sits there.

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: Это секрет, который умрёт вместе со мной.
examples.trans: It's a secret that will die with me.

examples.text: Мы с Пашей вместе уже месяц.
examples.trans: Pasha and I have been together for a month now.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: Удачи! = Good luck! (genitive: 'I wish you luck')

examples.trans: That's a real stroke of luck.

examples.text: Нет, не получается у меня это забыть. Удачи тебе на новом месте работы.
examples.trans: No, I just can't forget it. Good luck to you in your new job.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.
